test_title: PYST 10: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 02 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the following series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 5 1 3 8 4 5 1 6 3 7 1 9 2 5 9 4 8 5 5 3 1 2 2 1 6 2 8 (Right)

How many such odd numbers are there each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number?15356
solution: Given series: (Left) 5 1 3 8 4 5 1 6 3 7 1 9 2 5 9 4 8 5 5 3 1 2 2 1 6 2 8 (Right) According to the question: Required condition: Odd number - Odd number - Even number
